beaches.name: Camping Beach (Antiparos)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is permitted on part of Camping beach, north of Antiparos town. The Municipality of Antiparos states on its beaches page that nudism is permitted on a section of the beach, without identifying the section; the rest is ordinary swimwear use. Visitor reports through 2023 place the nude section on the smaller beach beyond the headland facing Diplo islet and describe a painted "official nudist beach" sign present in some years and absent in others.

beaches.name: Livadia
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported beyond the low rock ridge at the far end of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to 2022; the far section was fully nude in 2017 and 2018 and about half nude in 2022, while the near end is mixed or textile. The beach is remote, reached by a rough west-coast road.
